verdict.rationale: Firecrawl publishes extensive first-party docs for a public HTTP API: named endpoints such as `/v2/parse` and the `scrape` endpoint with JSON schema extraction, API-key authentication with server-side controls, async webhooks with HMAC signing, and SDKs that wrap the raw HTTP calls. The docs are also exposed to agents through an llms.txt index of 203 v2 pages. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (every probed path returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
